excluded.evidence: op 'matrix' (a general matrix) has no single INSERT form: one INSERT carries translation, one rotation about the normal and three scales, and no shear. A three-level nested INSERT chain (rotate, scale, rotate) could carry its 2x2 part through a singular value decomposition, but those factors would be derived values compared under policy and not EXACT, and the probe's own truth is a rejection outcome that no reader-mapping check can exercise, so that was not attempted

UNSUPPORTED: A dimension is an annotation whose lines and arrowheads live in a generated anonymous block and a style. v1 has no annotation entity and does not explode one.
MISSING: The drawing holds no entity at all, so the converter is expected to emit nothing.
IGNORED: A pattern fill is presentation. It has no stroke of its own and the boundary it fills is not asserted as a curve, so v1 drops it by policy.
IGNORED: A gradient fill is presentation with a colour ramp on top of a hatch. v1 drops it by policy and never renders a ramp.
IGNORED: A raster image is an external pixel reference, not vector geometry. v1 drops it by policy.
UNSUPPORTED: A subdivision mesh is faceted surface geometry, outside the 2D profile. It is recognised and refused.
IGNORED: Multiline text is not geometry v1 carries, and no glyph outline is promised. It is dropped by policy.
UNSUPPORTED: An embedded OLE object is a foreign document, not geometry. It is recognised and refused.

MISSING: A proxy or custom entity is opaque application data with no decodable geometry, and a reader that cannot instantiate it returns nothing for it. The converter is expected to emit nothing, which is different from recognising and refusing it.
UNSUPPORTED: A region is an ACIS face, outside the 2D profile. It is recognised and refused.
UNSUPPORTED: An ACIS solid is three-dimensional boundary-representation data, outside the 2D profile. It is recognised and refused.
UNSUPPORTED: A table is a grid of generated lines and text with a style. v1 has no table entity and does not explode one.
IGNORED: Single-line text is not geometry v1 carries, and no glyph outline is promised. It is dropped by policy.
IGNORED: A wipeout is a masking boundary, a display effect that draws nothing of its own. v1 drops it by policy.
UNSUPPORTED: An external reference points at geometry in another file that the pipeline does not resolve. It is recognised and refused.
